test_A_shibata.lock_model_note: CONCEPT_ONLY. Rotary lock (回転錠) with vertical pivot, fully inside its own housing. The partner's round protrusion (突起, a knuckle with a neck groove at its base) enters this head's chamber (懐); its head pushes the lock nose aside against the spring (PDF p3 §2.2, D grade). When the faces meet, the neck groove reaches the nose, the spring returns the lock and the nose sits in the groove behind the protrusion head (wedge). Lock-to-lock face contact of the real design is NOT modelled; replace when G0-B drawings arrive. NOTE for VO: in this model the lock catches the partner's PROTRUSION inside its OWN chamber (VO S2 says '상대편 잠금실에' - re-check wording after G0-B).
